description: Source code for the UserService class in the Mattermost plugin API, providing methods to manipulate user data, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, status management, profile image handling, permission checks, LDAP attributes, and access tokens.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class providing user management functionalities within the Mattermost plugin API.

methods.name: GetByEmail
methods.description: Retrieve a user by email address.

methods.name: List
methods.description: List users based on search options.

methods.name: ListInChannel
methods.description: List users in a specific channel with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: ListInTeam
methods.description: List users in a specific team with pagination.

methods.name: ListStatusesByIDs
methods.description: Get statuses for multiple users by IDs.

methods.name: HasPermissionTo
methods.description: Check if user has system scope permission.

methods.name: HasPermissionToTeam
methods.description: Check if user has team scope permission.

methods.name: HasPermissionToChannel
methods.description: Check if user has channel scope permission.

methods.name: RolesGrantPermission
methods.description: Check if roles grant a specific permission.

methods.name: GetLDAPAttributes
methods.description: Retrieve LDAP attributes for a user.

methods.name: CreateAccessToken
methods.description: Create a new access token for a user.
